descByPlatform.chatgpt: Create an ultra-realistic 8K mid-shot portrait with a warm romantic "golden-hour muse" aesthetic inspired by Vogue Fine Arts and Italian painting studios. Outfit: cream or soft beige off-shoulder knit top with exposed collarbone, thin gold necklace, tiny pearl earrings, subtle gold rings. Background: a large colorful oil painting of the subject filling the entire frame in soft warm golden, peach, and blush brushstrokes. Pose: mid-shot slightly off-center, exposed shoulder toward camera, head slightly down, eyes softly lifted. Camera: Canon EOS R5, 50mm f/1.2, ISO 160.

descByPlatform.flux: An exquisitely rendered ultra-realistic 8K mid-shot portrait inspired by the "golden-hour muse" aesthetic — a fusion of Vogue Fine Arts editorial and classical Italian painting studio portraiture. The subject's hair falls in natural soft loose waves with generous volume and a luminous warm golden glow kissing each strand. Makeup is impeccably crafted: dewy glass-luminous skin with golden highlighter on cheekbones, sun-kissed peach eyeshadow, long feathery fluffy lashes, soft rosy watercolor blush, and beautifully glossy peach-rose lips. She wears a refined cream off-shoulder knit or lightly draped top, exposing the collarbone and one shoulder elegantly. Jewelry: fine thin gold chain necklace, tiny freshwater pearl stud earrings, and subtle slim gold rings. The background is entirely filled by a large expressive hand-painted oil painting of the subject — sweeping warm brushstrokes in golden honey, soft peach, blush rose, and creamy ivory. Pose: mid-shot, slightly off-center, exposed shoulder angled toward camera, head tilted fractionally downward while eyes lift softly with dreamy introspective warmth. Canon EOS R5, 50mm f/1.2 lens, ISO 160, soft golden-hour warmth, glowing skin meets glowing canvas, 8K ultra-sharp rendering.
